intro.title: Design Real-Time Dashboard
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a real-time dashboard that displays live data updates, such as stock prices or sensor readings, in a clean, responsive layout. You will learn how to use Angular's built-in HttpClient to fetch data from a mock API and how to bind this data to your template using interpolation and property binding. The core concept involves managing component state to handle dynamic data and updating the UI reactively as new information arrives. By the end, you'll have a functional dashboard that automatically refreshes with simulated real-time data, giving you hands-on experience with Angular components, services, and data binding.
intro.usecase: Real-time dashboards are essential in modern applications that require live data monitoring and decision-making. Developers build these for financial trading platforms showing live stock prices, operations centers tracking delivery fleets, or analytics tools displaying website traffic as it happens. In Angular, implementing such dashboards involves managing dynamic data streams, updating UI components efficiently, and providing responsive visualizations. Mastering this pattern prepares you for building critical monitoring interfaces across industries like finance, logistics, and IoT systems.
